views.text: In November 2022, Equity Mates contrasted another acquirer with IAC, saying IAC’s model was to spin businesses out rather than roll them up, underscoring its unique approach to capital allocation.

In February 2022, Equity Mates explained IAC aggregated internet businesses into units and regularly spun them off, giving shareholders stock in the new entities as part of its capital allocation playbook.
